description: Simulated incident timeline for the Day 4 triage exercise. All hosts, users, and indicators are fictional. Zero real network involved.

events.detail: alice (finance) authenticates to WS-101 from office network, normal hours
scheduled backup job starts on FILESRV-02, expected window
alice receives external email with attachment 'invoice.doc' from unknown sender
admin runs Windows Update on WS-114, expected maintenance
powershell.exe launches with encoded command line, parent is WINWORD.exe
helpdesk resets bob's password per ticket #4417
scheduled task 'Updater' created by powershell.exe, runs at user logon
backup service uploads 40GB to corporate cloud storage, expected job
WS-101 authenticates to FILESRV-02 over SMB as alice
mass read of 12,000 files on finance share from FILESRV-02 session
IT deploys software package via deployment tool to 40 hosts
2.3GB HTTPS upload from FILESRV-02 to unknown external host
endpoint agent raises alert: encoded powershell on WS-101 (late detection)

notes: Benign noise included: e01, e02, e04, e07, e09, e12. e14 is a late detection, not part of the chain.
scenario: Fictional company 'Acme'. One workstation and one file server involved. Work the timeline like a responder.
